■ Direction Note
眩む = kuramu (dazzled / blinded)
...I knew it, as expected.

At this rate, there's no way I can run well against
McQueen-san, is there? Winning is impossible, right?

Please answer me honestly.
If things stay as they are, what will happen?

Um, would you... rather not?
Challenge McQueen-san together with me, that is.

Dia-chan... what incredible drive...
A-Alright. Let's go one more time!

Yes, Trainer! Please watch Dia more, learn more
about me, and guide me forward!

...I want to become a diamond! To be recognized by Father and Mother,
and shine brightly as a diamond in my family's history...!

But Trainer... this really is the limit.
Dia-chan hasn't even debuted yet...
Are you... sure about this?

Dia-chan... you're amazing... truly amazing...
To keep up with the exact same training as me, when stamina is my only forte.

...! Will you please lend your strength and your future
to Dia? Everyone will understand. So please!

Let us see on the track just what and how much you have honed.
Without holding back in the slightest, of course.

I can still... still keep going, Trainer!!
The only reason I'm struggling is because I'm not good enough yet...!

Two earnest resolves and cries clashing together... This is a crossroads of destiny.
I must choose something, sacrifice something—and decide on our course.

It cannot be helped. One cannot go against your mother, after all.
The distance will be "2,400 meters, the same as the Japanese Derby."

(I've done... I've done everything I could possibly do.
All that remains is—)

So please, please, Trainer.
Train Dia so that McQueen-san will acknowledge me!

It's not enough... this isn't nearly enough...! Sharp acceleration alone
won't let me run against McQueen-san over 2,400 meters...!

As her partner, I can't lie to her.
I calmly give my outlook.

But I truly believe! That without you, who looked straight at my running
without being dazzled by my family name, I will never be able to truly shine. That is why...!

A premier distance requiring not just sharp bursts, but also stamina and pacing.
Show me enough there to make them say, "There is no doubt about this duo."
Her best friend came forward as the perfect training partner.

McQueen-san is... incredibly strong... On top of that, 2,400 meters
is completely uncharted territory, so she won't acknowledge us easily.

If I can't overcome this with you, our dreams will never come true...
Neither my dream, nor the Satono family's dream. And if that happens, the very reason I was born...

Therefore, I must ask you to undergo a test.
Not just you... but both of you.

Stop it already, Dia-chan! You're gonna hurt yourself!
Trainer-san, please stop her!

Wait, McQueen-san is the examiner?!
Isn't the gap in their abilities way too big...? But why...?

You appear to be quite focused.
...Well, as long as you are able to run, that is fine with me.

The meeting with the Satono Group's representatives—Satono Diamond's parents—
was held in the reserved Student Council room.

The reason we didn't debut together was because my growth
happened faster than hers... So if I push her all the way to her limits...

I understand how you feel, but without even assessing your ability,
I simply cannot grant my approval.
Haa... haa... *cough*, *wheeze*... hauu...

And so, Satono-san, Trainer-san, I shall be your examiner.
In one month's time, race against me and show me what you are truly capable of.
(All I need to do now is unleash this against McQueen-san!)

*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*... *pant*...! Kita-chan, one more rep!
Just one more...!

—!? Satono-san, you...
Covered in all that mud... can you even run properly like that?

Father, Mother. This is my Trainer!
They possess truly remarkable insight. So please, give us your approval—!

Her opponent is one of Tracen Academy's absolute top-tier stayers. With her current level of mastery,
it will be difficult to run well in a 2,400m trial and secure her approval.

To win a GⅠ and shine at the pinnacle of the Twinkle Series.
As our first step toward that goal, the two of us began running toward the trial.

Let's go back to basics. What's most important is keeping my priorities straight.
The greatest reason for joining hands with Satono Diamond is...

...I truly... want to go together with you, Trainer.
To the Twinkle Series.

A few days after making that fateful decision...
—The day arrived when everything would be put to the test.

Yaaaahhhhh!
HAAAAAAAH!

I am so sorry. Even though I was the one who asked you,
it ended up turning into something like this...
